AssetPlus is looking for a Senior Associate \- Design to create high\-quality visual experiences across marketing, digital and brand communication. This is a hands\-on execution role requiring strong expertise in graphic design, motion graphics and video production, with the ability to deliver engaging creatives across multiple formats.
 



  





 The role will work closely with Brand, Content, Performance Marketing, Product and other business teams to create campaigns, websites, landing pages, presentations, social media creatives and video content. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, have a strong eye for detail, and adopt an AI\-native approach to design and creative production.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Creative Design \& Brand Execution** 



* Create high\-quality creatives across digital, print and marketing channels while ensuring consistency with AssetPlus brand guidelines.
* Design assets for campaigns, social media, emailers, presentations, sales collateral, events and internal communication.
* Maintain high standards of typography, layout, visual hierarchy and overall craft across every deliverable.



  





**2\. Motion Graphics \& Video Production** 



* Create engaging motion graphics and videos across both long\-form and short\-form formats.
* Develop videos for educational content, product launches, social media, events, campaigns and internal communication.
* Apply strong storytelling principles, pacing, transitions and animation techniques to create engaging content across brands.



  





**3\. Website \& Landing Page Design** 



* Design responsive websites and landing pages that provide a seamless user experience and support marketing objectives.
* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to translate briefs into visually engaging and conversion\-focused digital experiences.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to rapidly prototype and create landing pages where appropriate.



  





**4\. Campaign \& Marketing Support** 



* Design creatives for integrated marketing campaigns across organic, performance and partner channels.
* Work closely with content, performance marketing and brand teams to deliver campaigns that are visually compelling and aligned with business objectives.
* Support the creation of presentations, event branding and sales enablement assets.



  





**5\. Design Systems \& Production Excellence** 



* Work within established design systems and contribute to expanding reusable templates, component libraries and creative assets.
* Follow production standards and quality assurance processes to ensure every deliverable is accurate, consistent and production\-ready.
* Organise files, maintain version control and contribute to the central design asset repository.



  





**6\. AI\-enabled Design Workflow** 



* Adopt an AI\-native approach to design by leveraging AI tools for ideation, image generation, motion graphics, video editing, presentation design and landing page creation.
* Continuously explore emerging AI tools and workflows that improve creative quality and execution speed.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5 to 10 years of experience in graphic design, visual communication or creative design.
* Strong portfolio showcasing branding, marketing campaigns, websites, landing pages, presentations and digital creatives.
* Strong hands\-on experience in motion graphics and video production across both long\-form and short\-form content.
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro and InDesign.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered design tools for image generation, video creation, presentation design and landing page development.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in fintech, edtech or digital\-first businesses will be an added advantage.

**Senior UX Designer \- Digital ProductsAbout The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior UX Designer** 
 to drive the user experience across a diverse portfolio of digital products and applications. This is a highly hands\-on role for a designer who can take a product from
 **problem discovery and user research through information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, and implementation collaboration** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong UX fundamentals with a solid understanding of modern web technologies and has
 **hands\-on experience with React and front\-end UI development** 
 . You should be comfortable working closely with product managers, engineers, QA, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into intuitive, scalable, and visually polished experiences.
   

  

 This is not a purely visual design role. We are looking for someone who can
 **think deeply about user problems, challenge requirements, simplify complex workflows, and translate those insights into exceptional product experiences.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end UX design process across multiple digital products and platforms.
* Translate business requirements, user needs, and complex workflows into intuitive and effective user experiences.
* Conduct user research, user interviews, usability analysis, and competitive/product research where appropriate.
* Develop user journeys, personas, information architecture, wireframes, interaction models, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
* Design intuitive workflows for complex enterprise and customer\-facing applications.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams from concept through implementation.
* Create and maintain reusable design systems, UI patterns, components, and interaction standards to ensure consistency across products.
* Collaborate with React engineers and have the ability to understand, review, and contribute to front\-end implementation where appropriate.
* Translate designs into production\-quality UI in collaboration with engineering, with the ability to make hands\-on React/UI changes when required.
* Review implemented experiences and ensure the final product closely aligns with the intended UX and design specifications.
* Identify usability issues, friction points, and opportunities for simplification and continuously improve the product experience.
* Ensure designs follow responsive design, accessibility, usability, and modern web UX best practices.
* Present design concepts and rationale clearly to senior stakeholders and incorporate feedback effectively.
* Establish UX standards and best practices that can be applied consistently across the broader product portfolio.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 6\+ years of professional UX/Product Design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end product design work.
* Strong expertise in UX design principles, interaction design, information architecture, usability, and user\-centered design.
* Proven experience designing complex web applications, SaaS products, enterprise platforms, or other digital products.
* Strong proficiency with tools such as Figma for wireframing, prototyping, high\-fidelity design, and design systems.
* Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility, interaction patterns, and modern UI/UX principles.
* Hands\-on experience developing or modifying web UIs using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Ability to understand existing React code and translate design requirements into practical, implementable UI solutions.
* Experience working with component\-based design systems and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between UX design, front\-end architecture, APIs, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments with cross\-functional engineering and product teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complex problems and workflows.


**Good to Have**
* Experience designing AI/GenAI\-powered products and experiences, including conversational interfaces, AI assistants, copilots, or AI\-driven workflows.
* Experience with modern React ecosystems such as Next.js, TypeScript, or component libraries.
* Experience creating and maintaining enterprise\-scale design systems.
* Familiarity with usability testing and analytics\-driven UX optimization.
* Understanding of front\-end performance, responsive behavior, and accessibility standards such as WCAG.
* Experience working across multiple products, platforms, or business domains.
* Experience mentoring junior UX/UI designers or establishing UX practices within an engineering/product organization.


**What We're Looking For**
 The ideal candidate is someone who:
   

  

* Thinks like a UX practitioner first and is passionate about solving user problems rather than simply creating visually attractive screens.
* Can independently take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a well\-thought\-out user experience.
* Is comfortable going from whiteboard → wireframe → prototype → high\-fidelity design → React implementation.
* Has strong attention to detail and cares about the quality of the final implemented experience, not just the design handoff.
* Can balance user needs, business objectives, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.
* Is comfortable challenging existing assumptions and advocating for the user.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, product\-oriented environment with multiple concurrent initiatives.


**Education**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in
 **Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related discipline** 
 is preferred. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
   

  

**Portfolio Requirement**
**A Strong Portfolio Is Required. Candidates Should Demonstrate**
* End\-to\-end UX case studies
* Complex workflow or application design
* UX problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs
* Design\-system/component work
* Examples of collaboration with engineering teams
* Where applicable, examples of React/UI implementation or hands\-on front\-end development

 **We help the Group to become better by making finance easy. We are THE partner organization for finance and accounting.**

 **"Excellence in Financial Services. Simply Delivered."**
 Ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of Finance Services? Join the team and bring your expertise on board! As part of DHL Group, you will be working with a global network of Finance Services colleagues as well as our business units and divisions and benefit from a wide range of development opportunities. If you are looking for an interesting role in a dynamic and diverse group, join us in our APAC region.
   

  

 We are looking for an immediate, full\-time, permanent position in APAC at Chennai, India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 The BPO team of Finance Services is responsible for three areas.
   

  

  

* strategic finance projects for and with all DHL Group divisions.
* classic process optimization projects
* digitalization projects for the Finance Services division.


**Your tasks:**
* In your central role in the Shared Service Center, you take end‑to‑end ownership of a Task Mining solution to drive process excellence and process intelligence. You are responsible for supporting the introduction and ensuring the successful operation of our cloud‑based Task Mining platform (KYP.ai) across finance teams. This includes overseeing its configuration and administration, such as user and role management, process‑specific monitoring parameters, and technical coordination with IT and the external vendor within our SaaS and cloud environment.
* A core part of your role is turning data into insight. You will analyze user‑interaction data to create process transparency, identify inefficiencies and enable data‑driven decision making across key finance processes such as Purchase‑to‑Pay, Order‑to‑Cash and Record‑to‑Report. Based on these insights, you will work with the business to recommend process improvements or automation initiatives (such as RPA or workflow automation) and oversee the continuous optimization of the solution, including its potential integration into the reporting landscape (e.g. via SQL‑based data models, APIs or BI tools).
* You will support users through focused trainings and ongoing operational support, ensuring correct interpretation and effective use of Task Mining insights, while acting as the local expert for functional and data privacy related questions.
* As the product owner and main point of contact, you will work closely with local and global stakeholders, report progress and realized benefits to senior management, and collaborate with the wider automation and analytics community to ensure Task Mining complements and strengthens the overall digital process automation landscape.


**Your profile:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferably in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* At least 3 years of professional experience in software implementation, process optimization or comparable digital transformation initiatives
* Strong affinity for IT, data analysis and process automation, with hands‑on exposure to process automation, analytics or BI tools
* Experience with Process Mining, Task Mining or RPA technologies (e.g. KYP.ai, Celonis, UiPath) is highly advantageous
* Understanding of finance processes such as Purchase‑to‑Pay, Order‑to‑Cash and Record‑to‑Report; experience in finance shared services is a plus
* Comfortable working with large, semi‑structured datasets and identifying meaningful patterns and insights
* Familiarity with SaaS platforms and system configuration; basic knowledge of SQL, scripting or BI tools is a plus
* Excellent communication skills in English
* You have strong analytical and conceptual skills, pay attention to detail, proactively solve challenges and enjoy working independently with a focus on results
* You are a creative and responsible team player
* Agentic AI automation


**We offer:**
* Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world
* International and virtual environment
* Flexibility and great opportunity to learn
* Tempting Compensation and benefits


 DHL Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Avaz AAC is a picture\- and text\-based communication app designed for children and adults with complex communication needs.
 





 Our mission is to make effective communication accessible to every person who needs it. Achieving this requires us to understand communicators and their support networks deeply, translate that understanding into reliable products and continuously improve the communication experience.
 




  





**About the team** 





 We are a team of passionate individuals working towards a more accessible and inclusive world where everyone has the opportunity to communicate and be heard. Our product team brings together product managers, designers, developers and QA, with empathy at the centre of how we work.
 





 We create space for fresh ideas, different perspectives and thoughtful experimentation. Team members are encouraged to question assumptions, explore new approaches and learn directly from the people who use our products. We believe meaningful innovation comes from combining curiosity, open collaboration and a deep understanding of our users.
 




  





**What you’ll do** 





 Own the end\-to\-end design process for Avaz AAC and other upcoming apps and portals in the Avaz suite. title: Instructional Designer - QA
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 We are looking for an Instructional Design QA Specialist to review learning content across scripts, storyboards, animatics and final production.
   

  

 The role is responsible for ensuring that each piece of content communicates its intended concept clearly, accurately and effectively. The specialist will evaluate the relationship between narration, visuals, activities and learning outcomes while converting recurring feedback into practical SOPs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Review scripts, storyboards, animatics and final videos for instructional effectiveness.
* Verify alignment with defined learning objectives, content briefs and intended audiences.
* Assess whether concepts are introduced in a clear and logical sequence.
* Check explanations, examples, activities and summaries for accuracy and relevance.
* Ensure visuals, animation and on\-screen text correctly support the narration.
* Identify confusing explanations, missing learning steps, contradictions and unnecessary repetition.
* Evaluate pacing, information density, cognitive load and audience engagement.
* Review language for clarity, simplicity, grammar and audience appropriateness.
* Review content for cultural sensitivity, inclusivity and appropriate representation.
* Validate consistency across approved scripts, storyboards, voice\-over, subtitles and final output.
* Identify audiovisual issues that affect comprehension, including unclear visuals, poor timing, incorrect emphasis and distracting presentation.
* Classify issues by category, severity and production stage.
* Provide clear, timestamped and actionable feedback to production teams.
* Distinguish genuine instructional defects from subjective creative preferences.
* Collaborate with instructional designers, subject\-matter experts, writers, animators and production leads.
* Track recurring feedback and convert it into SOPs, checklists and preventive guidelines.
* Analyse rejected or repeatedly revised content to identify root causes and process gaps.
* Participate in pre\-production reviews to prevent issues from reaching later stages.
* Conduct final compliance and quality checks before delivery.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of instructional design and learning principles.
* Ability to evaluate whether content effectively communicates the intended concept.
* Strong attention to detail, logical reasoning and analytical ability.
* Excellent written communication and feedback\-documentation skills.
* Ability to review audiovisual content from both learner and production perspectives.
* Understanding of audience comprehension, cognitive load and content progression.
* Ability to create structured QA frameworks, SOPs and checklists.
* Confidence in challenging unclear or ineffective instructional decisions with sound reasoning.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables, review stages and deadlines.
* Strong working proficiency in English \& Hindi


**Preferred Experience**
* 1\.5\-5 years of experience in instructional design, content quality assurance, educational content review or digital learning production.
* Experience reviewing videos, animation, digital lessons or interactive learning content.
* Familiarity with scripts, storyboards, animatics, voice\-over, subtitles and video\-production workflows.
* Experience working with learning objectives, content standards and subject\-matter experts.
* Familiarity with issue trackers, spreadsheets, review platforms or content\-management systems.

title: UX Designer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking a talented UX Designer (Grade 26\) to join the UX Design team for Optum® Crimson AI \- an AI\-enabled clinical analytics and business intelligence platform used by hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Crimson AI integrates directly with a health system's EHR and brings clinical, financial, scheduling and supply chain data together into a single modular platform, layering predictive analytics, AI\-generated recommendations and a conversational AI experience on top of it. Analysis that once required weeks of manual data mining is now delivered in seconds.
   

  

 This is a design role in which data is the product. Our users come to Crimson AI to identify an opportunity, understand what is driving it, and decide what to do next. Your work makes that path short, clear and trustworthy.
   

  

 The role combines user experience design, product thinking, data visualization and AI\-enabled design capabilities to deliver solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science and Business stakeholders, you will contribute to the design and evolution of complex digital products, transforming user insights and business requirements into engaging and effective experiences.
   

  

 We work in short, iterative cycles in each Sprint. Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications \- you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.
   

  

 We are a closely knit team that shares work early, critiques generously and holds a high bar for craft. You will have real ownership of your product areas, direct access to the people who understand the data and the domain, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving these problems together.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, design concepts and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate product vision and functionality
* Apply user\-centered design methodologies to ensure usability, accessibility, and adoption
* Build a thorough working understanding of the product and the business behind it, and ask the incisive early questions that establish the real user problem, the intended business outcome and the measures of success \- then design against those rather than against a feature list
* Translate complex, multi\-source healthcare data into actionable insight. Develop a working understanding of how the underlying data relates \- what drives what, what can meaningfully be compared, and where the caveats sit \- and design the information hierarchy, data presentation and visualizations so that users can see the signal, trust it, and act on it
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis and user discovery activities to inform product and design decisions
* Translate complex business requirements, workflows, and data structures into intuitive and user\-friendly experiences
* Incorporate customer feedback, user research findings and market insights to refine designs and improve product outcomes
* Operate at pace: scope your own design approach, select the right fidelity for the decision at hand, and iterate as the team's understanding of the problem sharpens
* Perform AI\-driven product design and prototyping, and apply AI tooling to accelerate your own exploration and delivery
* Follow and help strengthen the defined UX guidelines, standards, and best practices across teams
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality user experiences
* Participate in usability testing, stakeholder workshops, design reviews, and design\-thinking sessions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment) The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in UX / Product Design, including hands\-on experience designing for data\-rich or analytics\-driven products
* Hands\-on experience with user research, usability testing, stakeholder workshops, and design sprint activities
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG / Section 508\) and inclusive design principles
* Proficiency in Figma and other industry\-standard design and prototyping tools
* Demonstrated product thinking: a track record of understanding product and business requirements quickly, asking the right questions of stakeholders, and producing design solutions that demonstrably serve both user needs and business goals. Portfolio should evidence the reasoning, not only the screens
* Proven ability to work with data hierarchy, data architecture and complex data relationships and to propose best\-in\-class designs for presenting them cdashboards, drill\-downs, comparative and benchmarked views, and insight\-led layouts that lead users to a decision
* Proven ability to work with self\-direction in areas of ambiguity: you can take an early or evolving problem statement, structure it, seek out the information you need, and move it forward without every step being defined for you
* Proven ability to work effectively in a high\-velocity, cross\-functional environment \- responsive to new information, efficient in revision, and pragmatic about sequencing what ships now versus what follows
* Proven ability to communicate product and design intent through demo\-ready prototypes and clear narrative \- work that travels well to customers, executives and internal stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate user needs, business goals and technical constraints into thoughtful design solutions
* Proven solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to product, engineering, data science and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of experience building products in the US healthcare analytics domain, with familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare data platforms, interoperability standards or population health analytics
* Experience designing for probabilistic or predictive outputs \- communicating confidence, uncertainty and recommendation provenance so that users know how much to trust what they are seeing
* Experience partnering with Product / Data Science / ML teams and defining success metrics for AI\-driven experiences, including generative AI, predictive analytics, conversational interfaces and intelligent workflows
* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and experience designing complex dashboards, reporting and analytics solutions


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
*\#NJP*
